name: Reverse Falls
source:
Reverse Falls is a visual novel, with some elements of point and click and mini-games. You follow the adventures of Pacifica and Gideon as they are trying to reveal the mysteries of Reverse.

[From [url=https://site.reversefalls.com/faq]Official FAQ[/url]]
translation:
《Reverse Falls》是一款视觉小说，带有一些点击和迷你游戏的元素。你将跟随帕西菲卡和吉迪恩的冒险，他们试图揭开逆转的奥秘。

[来自[url=https://site.reversefalls.com/faq]官方常见问题解答[/url]]
